steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: empty-bedroom
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setItems(s.items.filter(i => { const r = s.floorPlan.rooms.find(r => r.id === 'mainBedroom'); if (!r) return true; const [x, z] = i.position; return !(x >= r.origin[0] && x <= r.origin[0] + r.width && z >= r.origin[1] && z <= r.origin[1] + r.depth); })); s.enterRoomEditor('mainBedroom'); })()

steps.name: click-bed-chip
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => /queen bed/i.test(b.textContent)); if (!b) throw new Error('no Queen bed chip: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel button')].map(x => x.textContent.trim()).join('|')); b.click(); })()
